Preserve the historical source contract without copying the type-only current peer annotation. The owned library tsconfig explicitly sets strictPropertyInitialization to false; other compiler configurations are not qualified. This is a main-only source decision and claims no native execution, installed-peer behavioral inheritance, security clearance, 21.x, or G11.
